name: Appium Mobile Test Automation
certifications: No official Appium certification; assessed by capstone projects
ISTQB Advanced Level Test Automation Engineering (CTAL-TAE)

beginner.summary: For testers and developers starting mobile automation with Appium. Covers how Appium works, installing the server and drivers, Android emulators and iOS simulators, Appium Inspector, desired capabilities, locator strategies, interacting with native elements, waits, gestures with W3C actions, lists and scrolling, hybrid apps and webviews, mobile web, app lifecycle commands, device settings, screenshots and logs, page objects for screens, test data, TestNG and Maven runs and running a suite on a device cloud.
prerequisites: Has tested mobile apps by hand
Basic Java or another programming language
Can install Android Studio; a Mac with Xcode is needed for the iOS days
outcomes: Install Appium with drivers and run tests on Android emulators and iOS simulators
Locate and interact with native, hybrid and web elements reliably
Automate gestures, scrolling and app lifecycle steps
Organise tests with screen objects and run them with Maven locally and on a device cloud

intermediate.summary: For testers and SDETs who write Appium tests and now build a team framework. Covers framework design, driver management and thread safety, configuration for devices and environments, parallel execution on emulators and grids, Appium plugins, image-based checks, visual testing, accessibility checks, performance signals, network mocking with proxies, push notifications and system interactions, biometrics, deep testing of webviews, BDD with Cucumber, Python and JavaScript clients, reporting, CI pipelines with emulators, flakiness, app builds and device farm strategy.
prerequisites: Writes Appium tests with screen objects, waits and gestures
Comfortable with Java, Maven and Git
Has run mobile tests on emulators and real devices
outcomes: Build a maintainable Appium framework for Android and iOS that a team can extend
Run suites in parallel on emulators, real devices and clouds
Add visual, accessibility, performance and network checks to mobile tests
Run mobile tests reliably in CI with clear reports

advanced.summary: For mobile automation leads and SDETs who run Appium across apps and teams. Covers mobile test strategy, framework architecture for many apps, self-hosted device farms, Appium on Kubernetes, scaling with clouds, test impact analysis, mobile security checks, privacy, resilience testing, performance engineering, testing apps built with Flutter and React Native, AI-assisted automation, observability for test runs, governance, migration to or from Espresso and XCUITest, Appium server internals and drivers, release quality gates, team enablement and troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Has built and maintained an Appium framework used by a team
Strong Java or another client language and CI skills
outcomes: Set mobile test strategy and architecture for many apps and teams
Run large mobile suites fast and reliably on device farms and clouds
Add security, privacy, resilience and performance testing to mobile quality
Lead mobile automation governance, migrations and capability
